summary: Python SDK: streaming chat hangs mid-response (stream never completes)
description: Customer reports Python SDK streaming chat occasionally stalls: the iterator keeps waiting and never yields a final chunk/close. Impact: request threads accumulate and app workers exhaust. Repro: python 3.11, redwood-sdk-python 1.8.2, using streaming chat endpoint with tool calling disabled. Steps: (1) start stream, (2) after ~1500 tokens generation stops, (3) connection remains open with no further events. Customer provided request_id samples and timestamps.
comments: Support (Camila): Confirmed we see open connections with no terminal event in logs; last event is a delta chunk, then silence.
Eng (Ethan): Suspect SSE client not handling server-side keepalive and missing final [DONE] when proxy buffers. Adding explicit read timeout + handling of comment/keepalive frames.
Eng (Ethan): Patch prepared in python SDK to treat blank lines and comment frames correctly; also surface a configurable stream timeout. Rolling into 1.8.3.
Support (Camila): Customer confirmed 1.8.3 resolves hangs over 24h canary. Closing ticket.
